statement.zh: Kosok 1965 据 1940s 调查识别中北部海岸密集石砌平台丘群（常称「Pativilca Complex」），并记录 Chupa Cigarro Grande 几乎无陶片。
statement.en: Kosok 1965, from 1940s survey, recognized dense stone platform-mound clusters on the north-central coast (often “Pativilca Complex”) and noted virtual absence of potsherds at Chupa Cigarro Grande.

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-24; bibliographic details verified via WebSearch/catalogs; no invented page numbers/coordinates/forged images.
